version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: 1.1.0: the console streams while the run is in flight instead of freezing REAPER until the child exits; a project switch mid-run no longer imports into the wrong project; only MIDI this run reported is imported, so stale exports are ignored; arguments are single-quoted (POSIX) and rejected when they contain Windows shell metacharacters; the output directory is always passed explicitly. 1.0.1: Basic Pitch transcription, Demucs stem separation, technique detection (slides/hammer-ons/pull-offs), MIDI/tab/JSON export.

reapack.name: Tab Agent Settings
reapack.desc: Configure Tab Agent Pro profiles and exports

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: 1.1.0: settings round-trip preserves empty fields (a blank threshold no longer shifts the remaining values); thresholds are validated before they are stored. 1.0.1: 8 preset profiles, instrument selection, install path, onset/frame thresholds, output directory, export format toggles.
